snippet.title: SS Morro Castle | SHIP EXPLORER | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
SHIP EXPLORER is the newest virtual experience from Turbine Room Studio based in Melbourne, Australia. It’s an immersive experience that puts you aboard famous ships from history as featured on the Oceanliner Designs YouTube channel. Players can interact with special items like ship’s horns and bells and on warships like Bismarck the guns will roar back to life. On top of that, a comprehensive and dynamic weather and time system means you can create the perfect vibe - exploring the ship at sunset on a calm summer’s night or in the middle of the fiercest Atlantic gale! Enter photo mode to fly around the ship externally in third person mode and snap exciting and unique angles - there’s always plenty to see. SHIP EXPLORER is launching on Steam in July 2025 with two ships - SS Morro Castle and the SS United States. In August, the first DLC ship will be free to all who have bought the game; the battleship Bismarck. After that most DLC ships will be paid additions to the game, the first being the Cunard liner RMS Lusitania. We can’t wait to show you what we have in store and give you the chance to explore these truly incredible mechanical and engineering marvels!

Learn more about Ship Explorer at https://www.shipexplorergame.com
